test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the following sentence.

This is really an attractive painting made by the __novice__ artist.
solution:
The correct answer is Expert.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'novice' means 'a person who is **new and without experience** in a certain job, situation, etc.'
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Mature- fully grown or fully developed.
 
• *Expert- a person who has a lot of special knowledge or skill.*
 
• Stylish- fashionable and attractive.
 
• Apprentice*- *a person who works for low pay, in order to learn the skills needed in a particular job*.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate antonym of the word 'Novice' is 'Expert'.
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.
